articles.title: Who is Mona Agarwal? Indian Shooter Who Won India's First Gold Medal at the Asian Para ...
articles.content: India have their hands on the first gold medal in the Asian Para Games 2026 on Monday October 19. Indian shooter Mona Agarwal has set an Asian Para Games record. Also, the silver medal in the same event was won by another Indian shooter, Avani Lekhara. It has been a bright start for India on the first day of the tournament. Explore more about Mona Agarwal’s performance at the Asian Para Games 2026, her life and her journey as an Indian para-shooter. How Mona Agarwal Won Gold and Avani Lekhara Bagged Silver? GOLD & SILVER MEDAL FOR INDIA IN SHOOTING AT ASIAN PARA GAMES! 🤩🥹 🥇 Mona Agarwal wins the Gold Medal 🥈 Avani Lekhara wins the Silver Medal Top 2 finish for India in the Women’s 10m Air Rifle Standing SH1 event!!!! WELL DONE GIRLS! 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥 https://t.co/Agw9zSV2si — The Khel India (@TheKhelIndia) October 19, 2026 Mona Agarwal and Avani Lekhara won the gold and silver medals, respectively, in the event. Both athletes started with close results across different stages and series. However, the game-changing moment came in Stage 2, Series 5, when Mona Agarwal took the lead over Lekhara by a very narrow margin of 0.1 points. She continued to maintain her lead and eventually won the event by 0.4 points. Mona Agarwal also set a new Asian Para Games record with her performance. Mona Agarwal vs Avani Lekhara: Series-Wise Points Stage / Series Mona Agarwal Avani Lekhara Stage 1 – Series 1 51.0 53.2 Stage 1 – Series 2 102.9 104.8 Stage 2 – Series 1 123.7 126.4 Stage 2 – Series 2 144.7 146.8 Stage 2 – Series 3 165.7 167.2 Stage 2 – Series 4 187.1 186.9 Stage 2 – Series 5 207.9 208.0 Stage 2 – Series 6 228.8 228.5 Stage 2 – Series 7 250.0 249.6 Total Points 250.0 249.6 Asian Para Games 2026 Shooting Final: Full Results Rank Athlete Country Total Points 1 Mona Agarwal India 250.0 2 Avani Lekhara India 249.6 3 Yunri Lee South Korea 227.9 4 Aigerim Tulegenova Kazakhstan 207.0 5 Miyoung Kim South Korea 186.3 6 Jie Zhong China 165.4 7 Anna Dovgelevich Kazakhstan 143.9 8 Wannipa Leungvilai Thailand 121.5 Meanwhile, South Korea’s Yunri Lee won the bronze medal after scoring 227.9 points. Who is Mona Agarwal? Mona Agarwal was born in Sikar district of Rajasthan on 8 November 1987. When she was 9 months old, she contracted polio, which affected both her lower limbs. Despite this, she continued to pursue her education and started working. However, she later decided to leave home and entered shooting in 2021, alongside pursuing a couple of other sports. She went on to win several key events, including the iconic bronze medal at the Paris Paralympics 2024. Below are her details and major achievements.
